en: The soldier has a pale yellowish brown head clothed in short pubescence, with reddish yellow mandibles and a yellowish white body. The head is squarish with nearly parallel sides, slightly wider at mid-length, the front margin shallowly concave and the hind margin almost straight. The labrum is semicircular; each hook-like mandible has a large blunt tooth behind the apical third and two minute teeth above the base. Antennae have 14 segments and the pronotum is saddle-shaped.
soldier: 头淡黄褐而覆短柔毛，上颚褐黄，胸腹黄白。头型稍方，两侧近平行，中段稍宽，前缘稍凹而後缘近平；上唇半圆形；上颚钩状，两颚各有一大钝齿位于颚端三分之一处之后，颚基上方各具二微齿；触角十四节，第三节稍长于第二节；后颏棍棒状，腰狭零点三四毫米；前胸背板马鞍状，后缘稍凸出。
